charts.title: TOI-1470 b: orbits around TOI-1470
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1470's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1470 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: González-Álvarez et al. 2023 (2023A&A...675A.177G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GONZ_AACUTE_LEZ__AACUTE_LVAREZ_ET_AL__2023): P 2.527093 d

charts.title: TOI-1470 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1470 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (58, 78, 85) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 284441182, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 8 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 11 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 8 min late; 5-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
